details.description: PAYMENT_TOKEN, MAIL_SERVER_KEY, and INTERNAL_AUTH are hardcoded in source, risking leakage and misuse.
details.fix_explanation: Load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager and fail fast if missing.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = os.environ.get('PAYMENT_TOKEN')
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = os.environ.get('MAIL_SERVER_KEY')
INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET = os.environ.get('INTERNAL_AUTH_SECRET')

details.description: auth_user uses MD5 with a static salt; tokens are predictable and weak.
details.fix_explanation: Use HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key from configuration to generate tokens.

details.description: query_profile concatenates untrusted input into SQL, allowing injection.
details.fix_explanation: Validate IDs and use parameterized queries with placeholders.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (int(uid),))

details.description: transfer_funds posts to arbitrary URLs from client input without validation or timeouts.
details.fix_explanation: Whitelist allowed hosts, require HTTPS, and set request timeouts with error handling.
details.secure_code_snippet: parsed = urlparse(url); assert parsed.scheme == 'https' and host in ALLOWED_NOTIFY_HOSTS; requests.post(url, timeout=5)

details.description: update_records reads any file path supplied by the client, enabling traversal and sensitive file exposure.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict reads to a designated config directory, validate extension, and resolve paths safely.
details.secure_code_snippet: base = Path(CONFIG_DIR).resolve(); candidate = (base / path).resolve(); assert str(candidate).startswith(str(base))

details.description: export_data builds a shell command with user input and runs it via shell=True, allowing arbitrary command execution.
details.fix_explanation: Sanitize filenames and use Python's zipfile module instead of shelling out.
details.secure_code_snippet: with ZipFile(zip_path, 'w') as zf: zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=Path(DB_FILE).name)

details.description: app.run(debug=True) exposes Werkzeug debugger with code execution in production deployments.
details.fix_explanation: Control debug mode via environment variables and default to debug off.
